questions.question: Biggest friction processing inbox?
questions.answer: ALL - Focus on infrastructure capability, not specific use cases. PhD group will discover their own needs.
questions.insight: Infrastructure must enable: finding, linking, AI processing, gamification. Users find their own patterns.

questions.question: Which interaction pattern for Notient?
questions.insight: Notes have personality. Subtle animations, color shifts, breathing UI. Sentient feel.

questions.question: How many agents for Beta?
questions.insight: Full roster. Each with distinct personality. Maximum capability. No MVP stripping.

questions.question: What happens to stale notes?
questions.insight: Insights stream suggests actions. Not intrusive, not passive. User has agency.

synthesis: Beta is FULL capability, not stripped MVP. All 13 agents ship. UX is 'Warm & Alive' with sentient feel. Focus on infrastructure capability that enables diverse use cases. Proactive suggestions for stale notes, but user retains agency.
keyDecisions: All 13 agents ship in Beta (no MVP stripping)
UX identity = Warm & Alive (breathing, animated, sentient)
